name: labs/sparks-baird__self-driving-lab-demo
title: CLSLab:Light NeoPixel + AS7341 (nonwireless serial)
intro: CLSLab:Light NeoPixel + AS7341 (nonwireless serial), adapted from sparks-baird/self-driving-lab-demo. It sets `color`; runs `measure_spectrum`. `measure_spectrum`: measure the eight fixed AS7341 bands through the current NeoPixel color, with the ATIME, ASTEP and gain settings the command carries; the reply is one list of eight intensities. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
